name: codeport
displayName: CodePort — Navigate Markdown to Source Code
description: Bring source-code navigation to Markdown. Resolve symbols in code blocks and inline code through a local CodePort index and your project's language servers (clangd first).

untrustedWorkspaces.description: CodePort starts language servers and writes a local index under .codeport/. In an untrusted workspace the index is not built.

virtualWorkspaces.description: CodePort needs a real file system to index sources and locate compile_commands.json.

codeport.definition.enabled.description: Enable go-to-definition (F12 / Ctrl+Click) for symbols inside Markdown code blocks and inline code.

codeport.references.enabled.description: Enable Find All References for symbols inside Markdown code blocks and inline code.

codeport.hover.enabled.description: Enable hover information (symbol kind, signature, definition site) inside Markdown code blocks and inline code.

codeport.codeLink.enabled.description: Turn `path/to/file.c:42` inside inline code into a clickable link that opens the file at that line.

codeport.codeLink.resolveRelativeToMarkd.description: Also resolve path links relative to the directory of the Markdown file itself (in addition to absolute paths and workspace-root-relative paths).

codeport.policy.markdownDescription:
How CodePort combines its two engines.

- `index-first`: consult the local index, accept it when confident, otherwise confirm with the language server.
- `lsp-first`: ask the language server first, fall back to the index.
- `index-only`: never start a language server.
- `lsp-only`: never use the local index.

codeport.policy.indexAcceptConfidence.markdownDescription: Confidence a single index candidate must reach for `index-first` to skip the language server.

codeport.index.enabled.markdownDescription: Build and use the local CodePort index (`.codeport/index.db`, tree-sitter + SQLite). Requires a VS Code with Node 22.5+ (for `node:sqlite`); otherwise CodePort silently falls back to the language server only.

codeport.index.prewarm.description: Build/sync the local index and start the project's language servers in the background when a supported project is opened.

codeport.index.references.markdownDescription: Also index symbol references (call sites). Increases index size and build time; reference *queries* still come from the language server.

codeport.index.maxFileSize.description: Skip files larger than this many bytes when indexing.

codeport.languages.markdownDescription: Map a Markdown code-fence language to an adapter id, e.g. `{ "c": "clangd", "cpp": "clangd" }`. Empty values use the built-in language detection.

codeport.clangd.path.description: Absolute path to the clangd binary. Empty = auto-detect (/usr/lib/llvm-*/bin/clangd, /usr/local/bin/clangd, /usr/bin/clangd, PATH).

codeport.clangd.arguments.description: Extra command-line arguments appended when launching clangd.

codeport.clangd.compileCommandsDir.markdownDescription: Directory containing `compile_commands.json`. Empty = auto-detect (workspace root, then upwards from the Markdown file).

codeport.trace.description: Log level for the CodePort output channel.
codeport.trace.markdownDescription: Log level for the CodePort output channel. `off` still reports warnings and errors.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
